# This file is the GOLDEN snapshot of the bhyve L0 nested-virt ABI.
# It is the expected output of the L0 dump helper (abisnap_dump)
# that the abisnap.sh test script writes to stdout.
#
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.  To regenerate after an intentional ABI
# change, run:
#
#   abisnap.sh --regen-golden --reviewer "Your Name"
#
# and follow the manual review + cp procedure printed by the
# script.  The script will NOT overwrite this file automatically;
# per the wave-7 plan, every ABI change requires human review.
#
# Format: one ABI entry per line, fields whitespace-separated.
# Each entry is one of:
#
#   NAME 0xOFFSET BITS
#
# where NAME is the architectural field/control/MSR name, OFFSET
# is the hex offset (in the VMCS12/VMCB12 page, or the MSR
# address), and BITS is the field width in bits.  Section headers
# are introduced by "# <SECTION>" lines.
#
# ABI-SNAPSHOT revision: 1
# generated-by: tests/sys/vmm/nested/abisnap/abisnap.sh
# generated-date: 2026-07-31
# corresponding-plan: .sisyphus/plans/nested-virt-register-virtualization.md (T39)

# VMCS12 — nVMX shadow VMCS layout
#
# Source: Intel SDM Vol. 3, Appendix B (VMCS field encodings).
# The 16-bit selector fields live at the high end of the
# VMCS12 region; 32-bit control fields in the middle; 64-bit
# natural-width fields at the low end.
#
# Encoding: high word of the field encoding is the access type
# (0=full, 2=high, others=control/guest/host widths); the
# low 16 bits are the field index.  See Intel SDM 24.11.2.

GUEST_ES_SELECTOR 0x0800 16
GUEST_CS_SELECTOR 0x0802 16
GUEST_SS_SELECTOR 0x0804 16
GUEST_DS_SELECTOR 0x0806 16
GUEST_FS_SELECTOR 0x0808 16
GUEST_GS_SELECTOR 0x080A 16
GUEST_LDTR_SELECTOR 0x080C 16
GUEST_TR_SELECTOR 0x080E 16

GUEST_ES_LIMIT 0x4800 32
GUEST_CS_LIMIT 0x4802 32
GUEST_SS_LIMIT 0x4804 32
GUEST_DS_LIMIT 0x4806 32
GUEST_FS_LIMIT 0x4808 32
GUEST_GS_LIMIT 0x480A 32
GUEST_GDTR_LIMIT 0x4810 32
GUEST_IDTR_LIMIT 0x4812 32
GUEST_TR_LIMIT 0x4814 32

GUEST_ES_BASE 0x6800 64
GUEST_CS_BASE 0x6802 64
GUEST_SS_BASE 0x6804 64
GUEST_DS_BASE 0x6806 64
GUEST_FS_BASE 0x6808 64
GUEST_GS_BASE 0x680A 64
GUEST_LDTR_BASE 0x680C 64
GUEST_TR_BASE 0x680E 64
GUEST_GDTR_BASE 0x6810 64
GUEST_IDTR_BASE 0x6812 64
GUEST_RIP 0x681E 64
GUEST_RSP 0x681C 64
GUEST_RFLAGS 0x6818 64

PIN_BASED_VMEXEC_CONTROL 0x4000 32
PROC_BASED_VMEXEC_CONTROL 0x4002 32
EXCEPTION_BITMAP 0x4004 32
VMEXIT_CONTROL 0x400C 32
VMENTRY_CONTROL 0x4012 32

# End of VMCS12 section

# VMCB12 — nSVM shadow VMCB layout
#
# Source: AMD APM Vol. 2, section 15.5 (VMCB Layout),
# Table 15-7 (VMCB offsets).  The VMCB page is 4 KiB;
# offsets below are taken from the AMD APM Table 15-7.
#
# The control area occupies offsets 0x000-0x3FF; the state-save
# area occupies 0x400-0xFFF.  Field widths are 8/16/32/64 bits
# depending on the architectural meaning.

# Hyper-V MSR list
#
# Source: Hyper-V TLFS 7.8.2 and 7.4.  Only MSRs that
# affect the L1-guest view are listed; purely host-side
# MSRs (e.g. VP assist page) are excluded because they
# are not part of the L0 <-> L1 ABI surface.
#
# MSR address encoding: the canonical TLFS address (low
# 32 bits, since RDMSR/WRMSR use ECX=MSR address).
